name: Phrasal verbs
note: A verb + particle whose meaning is often idiomatic (give up, put off, look after, run out of). With many, an object pronoun goes in the middle (turn it on, not turn on it).

questions.q: You've borrowed such a great deal of money from me lately. I need to ______ exactly how much you owe me.
questions.fs: You've borrowed such a great deal of money from me lately. I need to work out exactly how much you owe me.

questions.q: I want to ______ the dinner tonight so that you don't have to worry about feeding your kids.
questions.fs: I want to bring over the dinner tonight so that you don't have to worry about feeding your kids.

questions.q: An employee with 400 accrued sick leave hours at the end of the fiscal year will ______ into the new fiscal year 360 hours of sick leave and 8 hours of additional annual leave.
questions.fs: An employee with 400 accrued sick leave hours at the end of the fiscal year will carry over into the new fiscal year 360 hours of sick leave and 8 hours of additional annual leave.

questions.q: We've run ______ sugar. Could you please buy some more?
questions.fs: We've run out of sugar. Could you please buy some more?

questions.q: A scrum is a way of restarting a game of rugby union after an accidental infringement such as a ______
questions.fs: A scrum is a way of restarting a game of rugby union after an accidental infringement such as a knock on.

questions.q: You can tell by the way she talks and behaves that she ______ her mother.
questions.fs: You can tell by the way she talks and behaves that she takes after her mother.

questions.q: Can you ______ the time of the next train to Munich?
questions.fs: Can you find out the time of the next train to Munich?

questions.q: The girl with the purple hair wants to ______ from the group.
questions.fs: The girl with the purple hair wants to stand out from the group.

questions.q: India and Iran will continue to deepen ties and ______ bilateral projects, including the tri-nation pipeline and a multi-billion dollar gas deal.
questions.fs: India and Iran will continue to deepen ties and carry on with bilateral projects, including the tri-nation pipeline and a multi-billion dollar gas deal.

questions.q: Our teacher told us to ______ our work quietly.
questions.fs: Our teacher told us to get on with our work quietly.

questions.q: Neil liked to ______ early on Saturdays.
questions.fs: Neil liked to wake up early on Saturdays.

questions.q: What you have to do is to ______ a new idea that will enable us to make a lot of money.
questions.fs: What you have to do is to think up a new idea that will enable us to make a lot of money.

questions.q: I don't know how you ______ with such noisy brothers. It would drive me crazy.
questions.fs: I don't know how you put up with such noisy brothers. It would drive me crazy.

questions.q: The stranded crew ______ for the long journey at 5 am. They needed as much natural light as they could get.
questions.fs: The stranded crew set off for the long journey at 5 am. They needed as much natural light as they could get.

questions.q: You need not worry that you'll be left on your own because I'll always ______ you.
questions.fs: You need not worry that you'll be left on your own because I'll always stand by you.

questions.q: I'm broke. I have to ______ an idea for making money.
questions.fs: I'm broke. I have to come up with an idea for making money.

questions.q: Students were given five minutes to ______ the examination paper before they were told to start writing.
questions.fs: Students were given five minutes to look through the examination paper before they were told to start writing.

questions.q: Don't worry we'll have to wait a little longer because I'm sure he'll ______ soon.
questions.fs: Don't worry we'll have to wait a little longer because I'm sure he'll turn up soon.

questions.q: That maths exam was incredibly difficult. It took me ages to ______ some of the answers.
questions.fs: That maths exam was incredibly difficult. It took me ages to work out some of the answers.

questions.q: Ethan asked his girlfriend to ______ the music so he could hear it clearly in the car.
questions.fs: Ethan asked his girlfriend to turn up the music so he could hear it clearly in the car.

questions.q: Finland and the Finnish upper secondary education system constitute a good example of the fact that it is possible to ______ very extensive readjustments with a view to making a system more flexible and adapted to individualized learning.
questions.fs: Finland and the Finnish upper secondary education system constitute a good example of the fact that it is possible to carry through very extensive readjustments with a view to making a system more flexible and adapted to individualized learning.

questions.q: I'm sorry, James isn't ______ at the moment. Can I take a message?
questions.fs: I'm sorry, James isn't in at the moment. Can I take a message?

questions.q: Senior Constable Smith asked the suspect to ______ the police station at lunch time in order to answer some questions regarding his alleged involvement in a bank robbery.
questions.fs: Senior Constable Smith asked the suspect to drop by the police station at lunch time in order to answer some questions regarding his alleged involvement in a bank robbery.

questions.q: The time has now come when it will be necessary to ______ making a plan.
questions.fs: The time has now come when it will be necessary to see about making a plan.

questions.q: The government wants to ______ a new scheme to encourage people to start their own businesses.
questions.fs: The government wants to try out a new scheme to encourage people to start their own businesses.

questions.q: He could feel the back of his neck ______ when they started talking about the tragedy.
questions.fs: He could feel the back of his neck burn up when they started talking about the tragedy.

questions.q: China's cultural industry was given a boost last week after the government announced its plan to ______ cultural reform in more than 20 provincial areas.
questions.fs: China's cultural industry was given a boost last week after the government announced its plan to carry out cultural reform in more than 20 provincial areas.

questions.q: I don't mind helping you bake a cake, but just make sure you ______ everything when you've finished.
questions.fs: I don't mind helping you bake a cake, but just make sure you put away everything when you've finished.

questions.q: Leslie decided to ______ early from the party.
questions.fs: Leslie decided to take off early from the party.

questions.q: When irrigation has no ______ system, the evaporating water deposits a gradual build-up of salinization, which is eventually damaging to plant life.
questions.fs: When irrigation has no carry off system, the evaporating water deposits a gradual build-up of salinization, which is eventually damaging to plant life.

questions.q: The referee instructed both captains to stop their complaining and ______ the rugby match.
questions.fs: The referee instructed both captains to stop their complaining and get on with the rugby match.

questions.q: If you want to join that club, you have to ______ a form and send it to your secretary.
questions.fs: If you want to join that club, you have to fill out a form and send it to your secretary.

questions.q: Don't ______ your opportunity to increase sales by leveraging the power of email marketing.
questions.fs: Don't pass up your opportunity to increase sales by leveraging the power of email marketing.

questions.q: An eagle, if pressed for food, might ______ a small baby that had been left in the open unprotected, but such an opportunity must occur very rarely.
questions.fs: An eagle, if pressed for food, might carry off a small baby that had been left in the open unprotected, but such an opportunity must occur very rarely.

questions.q: A chiropractor who claims he can treat anyone by ______ in time to when an injury occurred has attracted the attention of State regulators.
questions.fs: A chiropractor who claims he can treat anyone by going back in time to when an injury occurred has attracted the attention of State regulators.

questions.q: Last week I ______ that book you wanted in a small shop.
questions.fs: Last week I came across that book you wanted in a small shop.
questions.x: A finished past time (“last week”) needs the past simple: came across.

questions.q: That store is really expensive. It's a ______
questions.fs: That store is really expensive. It's a rip-off.

questions.q: Animals and humans use the evaporation of water to ______ heat that is absorbed from the sun or generated by metabolic activity and exercise.
questions.fs: Animals and humans use the evaporation of water to carry away heat that is absorbed from the sun or generated by metabolic activity and exercise.

questions.q: The manager was very afraid the multi-million dollar deal would ______
questions.fs: The manager was very afraid the multi-million dollar deal would fall through.

questions.q: The liver regulates most chemical levels in the blood and excretes a product called bile, which helps ______ waste products from the liver.
questions.fs: The liver regulates most chemical levels in the blood and excretes a product called bile, which helps carry away waste products from the liver.

questions.q: He didn't ______ to new concepts easily.
questions.fs: He didn't catch on to new concepts easily.

questions.q: It's easy to see from the way the garden is looking that winter has ______
questions.fs: It's easy to see from the way the garden is looking that winter has set in.

questions.q: Everyone could see by the grimace on his face that he didn't ______ the meal in front of him.
questions.fs: Everyone could see by the grimace on his face that he didn't care for the meal in front of him.

questions.q: The Scottish Parliament has appointed Mr. Maley to ______ an assessment of the current cost estimate and likely completion date of a new information technology project.
questions.fs: The Scottish Parliament has appointed Mr. Maley to carry out an assessment of the current cost estimate and likely completion date of a new information technology project.

questions.q: Ellie had to ______ in order to make the green light. She's usually a pretty good driver.
questions.fs: Ellie had to speed up in order to make the green light. She's usually a pretty good driver.

questions.q: When spring comes, people often feel inclined to ______ their houses.
questions.fs: When spring comes, people often feel inclined to do up their houses.

questions.q: Teachers in Sydney have decided to call a snap strike next week after negotiations with the State Government over a ten percent pay increase ______ early this morning.
questions.fs: Teachers in Sydney have decided to call a snap strike next week after negotiations with the State Government over a ten percent pay increase broke down early this morning.

questions.q: I need to find some kind of chemical that will ______ the weeds in the garden.
questions.fs: I need to find some kind of chemical that will keep down the weeds in the garden.

questions.q: Chris was afraid the inexpensive tires would ______ quickly.
questions.fs: Chris was afraid the inexpensive tires would wear out quickly.

questions.q: Items such as pointed scissors and ice skates are examples of articles that are not permitted in your ______ baggage when boarding an aircraft.
questions.fs: Items such as pointed scissors and ice skates are examples of articles that are not permitted in your carry on baggage when boarding an aircraft.

questions.q: Leila was feeling blue, so she went shopping to ______ some new outfits.
questions.fs: Leila was feeling blue, so she went shopping to try on some new outfits.

questions.q: Heidi ______ an old friend while she was shopping last week.
questions.fs: Heidi ran into an old friend while she was shopping last week.

questions.q: Some married couples ______ each other over differences of opinion on how things could or should be done.
questions.fs: Some married couples fall out with each other over differences of opinion on how things could or should be done.

questions.q: Kevin ______ all of the information and then gave the note to his wife so she could put it into a computer file.
questions.fs: Kevin took down all of the information and then gave the note to his wife so she could put it into a computer file.

questions.q: Billy was so tired that he was ______ in class.
questions.fs: Billy was so tired that he was nodding off in class.

questions.q: Foreign companies will have to ______ the hat to pay for the extra costs of doing business in Indonesia.
questions.fs: Foreign companies will have to pass round the hat to pay for the extra costs of doing business in Indonesia.

questions.q: Samantha was late for the basketball ______
questions.fs: Samantha was late for the basketball tryout.

questions.q: It's so nice to ______ you again after all this time. I don't think I've seen you for at least twenty years.
questions.fs: It's so nice to run into you again after all this time. I don't think I've seen you for at least twenty years.

questions.q: Sweaters are easy to ______ , comfortable, warm, and above all, stylish.
questions.fs: Sweaters are easy to put on, comfortable, warm, and above all, stylish.

questions.q: The guard had to ______ the dogs when the master approached the locked gate.
questions.fs: The guard had to call off the dogs when the master approached the locked gate.

questions.q: A burglar ______ my house when I was away on vacation and stole some of my electronic goods.
questions.fs: A burglar broke into my house when I was away on vacation and stole some of my electronic goods.

questions.q: Even though he was exhausted, he ______
questions.fs: Even though he was exhausted, he kept going.

questions.q: They've been seeing each other for 6 months now or, as we used to say, they've been walking ______ together.
questions.fs: They've been seeing each other for 6 months now or, as we used to say, they've been walking out together.

questions.q: The view from the penthouse suite of the five-star hotel ______ over the Pacific Ocean.
questions.fs: The view from the penthouse suite of the five-star hotel looks out over the Pacific Ocean.

questions.q: Marty often ______ important issues at the meetings.
questions.fs: Marty often brought up important issues at the meetings.

questions.q: After the tragic accident, Lauren's mother had a nervous ______
questions.fs: After the tragic accident, Lauren's mother had a nervous breakdown.

questions.q: A total stranger walked ______ to me and asked if I could lend him some money.
questions.fs: A total stranger walked up to me and asked if I could lend him some money.

questions.q: One of the most memorable images of the war was created when U.S. troops ______ the statue of Saddam Hussein in Fardus Square.
questions.fs: One of the most memorable images of the war was created when U.S. troops pulled down the statue of Saddam Hussein in Fardus Square.

questions.q: We still have to ______ the finer details about our upcoming trip to Scotland.
questions.fs: We still have to iron out the finer details about our upcoming trip to Scotland.

questions.q: Professional boxers don't wear headgear because their intent is to ______ their opponent.
questions.fs: Professional boxers don't wear headgear because their intent is to knock out their opponent.

questions.q: Lawmakers shouldn't ______ the chance to regulate tobacco.
questions.fs: Lawmakers shouldn't pass up the chance to regulate tobacco.

questions.q: After one year, Ben decided to ______ He couldn't live with the guilt any longer.
questions.fs: After one year, Ben decided to turn himself in. He couldn't live with the guilt any longer.

questions.q: Bryan tapped Pauline on the shoulder so she would ______ and see the parade approaching behind them.
questions.fs: Bryan tapped Pauline on the shoulder so she would turn around and see the parade approaching behind them.

questions.q: Pakistani viewers will no longer be able to watch their favorite Bollywood movies, as the government has decided that all Indian cable channels will ______ the air at the end of this month.
questions.fs: Pakistani viewers will no longer be able to watch their favorite Bollywood movies, as the government has decided that all Indian cable channels will go off the air at the end of this month.

questions.q: Candace has a bad habit of ______ in front of others.
questions.fs: Candace has a bad habit of butting in in front of others.

questions.q: Randy was very nervous during his first flight lesson. Afterwards, he told me the best part was at the beginning, during ______
questions.fs: Randy was very nervous during his first flight lesson. Afterwards, he told me the best part was at the beginning, during take off.

questions.q: Entrepreneurs have several options when it comes to ______ a family business to their children.
questions.fs: Entrepreneurs have several options when it comes to passing on a family business to their children.

questions.q: The supervisor asked everyone to ______ for the manager's birthday present.
questions.fs: The supervisor asked everyone to chip in for the manager's birthday present.

questions.q: The new police chief is trying to ______ on the current drug problem in the city.
questions.fs: The new police chief is trying to crack down on the current drug problem in the city.

questions.q: Many parents assume that their children will ______ in school if they spend too much time playing video games.
questions.fs: Many parents assume that their children will drop behind in school if they spend too much time playing video games.

questions.q: Rick ______ a terrible cold this week.
questions.fs: Rick came down with a terrible cold this week.

questions.q: knew we shouldn't have trusted them because they suddenly left and walked ______ on us.
questions.fs: knew we shouldn't have trusted them because they suddenly left and walked out on us.

questions.q: Jim didn't have much time to ______ the contract.
questions.fs: Jim didn't have much time to write up the contract.

questions.q: A few months ago, James got a ______ his front door.
questions.fs: A few months ago, James got a knock on his front door.

questions.q: She had no family support system to ______ , and she couldn't afford daycare.
questions.fs: She had no family support system to fall back on, and she couldn't afford daycare.

questions.q: The Super Bowl champion Steelers have decided to ______ fullback Verron Haynes for at least another two seasons.
questions.fs: The Super Bowl champion Steelers have decided to bring back fullback Verron Haynes for at least another two seasons.

questions.q: The couple ______ of the hotel early this morning.
questions.fs: The couple checked out of the hotel early this morning.

questions.q: The whole community ______ to make the playground safe and aesthetic.
questions.fs: The whole community pitched in to make the playground safe and aesthetic.

questions.q: Rosie overslept because her alarm clock didn't ______ this morning.
questions.fs: Rosie overslept because her alarm clock didn't go off this morning.

questions.q: Visitors attending the annual Open House have the options of either participating in information sessions for their entire duration or ______ portions of the seminars based on their schedule and interest.
questions.fs: Visitors attending the annual Open House have the options of either participating in information sessions for their entire duration or dropping in on portions of the seminars based on their schedule and interest.
